growth_signal.value: Processes about $7 billion a year in stablecoin payments, annualized.

entry.idea: Businesses that get paid in stablecoins struggle to turn that money into cash they can actually spend, because banks and card networks only work during business hours, so HIFI builds the payment and settlement pipes that move stablecoins in and out of normal bank and card accounts at any time.
entry.lesson: When a new kind of money moves faster than the old banking system, build the plumbing that connects the two, rather than a new currency itself.
entry.name: HIFI

growth.reason: It already processes about $7 billion a year and just raised a much bigger round than its earlier seed funding, backed by Tether.

market.reason: Moving money between stablecoins and normal bank accounts and cards is a need for almost any business worldwide that touches digital dollars.

tech.reason: Linking stablecoin transfers to card networks and banks while handling compliance and clearing is a real edge that would take a strong team a year or two to match.

entry.twist: Its "Push to Card" feature lets a US business send money straight from its stablecoin balance onto a normal Visa debit or credit card in seconds, with no extra sign-up for the person receiving it.
entry.who_pays: US businesses that hold stablecoins pay to use HIFI's platform to move, control and cash out that money.
entry.why_now: Stablecoins move money nonstop, day and night and on weekends, but the banking system they connect to does not, so demand is growing fast for infrastructure that bridges the two.
